title: 1812: four more buildings outside the first fort
items: The 1812 scene gains the interpreter's house, the armourer's shop, the merchant's shop and the bake house, each found by its number on Captain Whistler's 1808 plan of the fort.
The middle of the three stables south of the agent's house is numbered 23 on the plan, so it is now the house in the factor's department. It has not moved.

The interpreter's house is drawn turned on the plan and stands turned. Its own written distance would have put it in the river, so it stands by the agent's house's figure instead, and Liberties says why.
